author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs cross-platform daily check-ins using Twitch/Kick rewards and YouTube/TikTok Viewer Foundation points.
changelog: 4.1.6: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.6, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with stable-ID daily uniqueness, configurable calendar time zone, monthly rollover, simulator-safe previews, and a bounded hosted leaderboard card.

manifest.name: Village Roll Call
installationSteps: Create Twitch and Kick check-in rewards. Keep both Reward Redemption triggers attached to your main platform actions.
Choose the check-in command name. It registers automatically for YouTube, TikTok and Facebook after restart.
Enable Viewer Foundation, choose the points cost and calendar time zone, then enable Village Roll Call.
Optionally add the hosted browser source to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs and send a preview.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private leaderboard is kept for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks one check-in per day, monthly resets, saved data limits, and overlay cards.
